d: Explore the historical roots of reservation in India through the visionary leadership of Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj of Kolhapur and his profound influence on Dr. B.R. Ambedkar. In 1902, Shahu Maharaj introduced a groundbreaking 50 percent reservation for backward classes in state jobs, laying the early groundwork for affirmative action and social justice. Discover how his mentorship, financial backing for the 'Mooknayak' newspaper, and support at the 1920 Mangaon Conference empowered Babasaheb’s lifelong struggle against caste inequality. From the Poona Pact to the Constituent Assembly…
